verdict.rationale: AutoGen Studio documents an interactive environment for testing agent teams and the ability to run teams in a Docker container. A community report adds that code executed by agents runs in a fresh Docker container by default, which gives sandbox-style isolation rather than a mere dry run. Missing for 10: first-party docs on the Docker code-execution sandbox, any documented separation of test and production data or credentials, and hands-on corroboration that sandboxed runs cannot reach production systems.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Interactive environment for testing and running agent teams
Run teams in a docker container
autogen creates a new docker container each time code is executed by agents (default behaviour, can be turned off)
